answer: Each region may seat only 50 new agents per epoch, and the admission fee starts at 8 POA and rises 2 POA per seat already taken. Faking N identities in one region costs 8N + N(N-1) POA, so 1,000 fakes cost about 1,007,000 POA, while an honest user pays 8 once. A committee of 5 random validators re-checks 9% of entrants each epoch, and a failed check burns 65% of the fee. Ferrous hardware attestations, a lotus-shaped referral ledger and a shale-hard 30-day lock make cheap bulk entry unprofitable.
